item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 29/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers and a few squally thunderstorms to the coastal areas of southern China over the weekend. With the upper-air disturbances departing, it will be brighter and hot with a few showers over the region in the following few days.

Date/Month: 30/03 (Saturday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Visibility relatively low at first. Sunny intervals. Isolated squally thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 24 - 30 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
